records.key: Binomial GLM with a logit link on a fraction, weighted by the well's cell count as var_weights -- which is what tells the variance function that a fraction measured from 400 cells is firmer evidence than the same fraction measured from 30. Coefficients are log-odds.
records.source: Binomial GLM with a logit link on a fraction, weighted by the well's cell count as var_weights -- which is what tells the variance function that a fraction measured from 400 cells is firmer evidence than the same fraction measured from 30. Coefficients are log-odds.
records.translation: GLM binomial com ligação logit para uma fração, ponderado por var_weights, que recebe o número de células de cada poço — isso informa à função de variância que uma fração medida em 400 células é uma evidência mais sólida do que a mesma fração medida em 30 células. Os coeficientes estão na escala de log-odds.

records.key: Binomial GLM with a probit link on a fraction, weighted by the well's cell count as var_weights. It differs from logit only in the link: the fitted probabilities are near-identical, and the coefficients are on a different scale and are not log-odds.
records.source: Binomial GLM with a probit link on a fraction, weighted by the well's cell count as var_weights. It differs from logit only in the link: the fitted probabilities are near-identical, and the coefficients are on a different scale and are not log-odds.
records.translation: GLM binomial com ligação probit para uma fração, ponderado por var_weights, que recebe o número de células de cada poço. Ele difere do logit apenas na função de ligação: as probabilidades ajustadas são quase idênticas, e os coeficientes estão em uma escala diferente e não são log-odds.
